seo.title: Luis Schulz – Pro triathlete and coach
seo.description: I'm Luis, a pro triathlete and coach from the Munich area. Here you'll find my races, my coaching and how you can support me.

heroTitle: I'm Luis. Pro triathlete and coach.
heroText: I'm from the Munich area and I love long-distance racing. I also coach a few athletes whom I support personally.
introText:
I started running in 2020 and got into triathlon at the end of 2022. The sport hasn't let go of me since. My best races so far were my two starts at Challenge Roth: an age group win in 2025 and a top 10 finish among all age-groupers in 2026.

As a coach I'm interested in sports science, but above all I'm interested in people. Finding the right approach for each person gives me a lot of joy.

pillars.title: About me
pillars.text: Where I come from and what I've set out to do.

pillars.title: Coaching
pillars.text: I coach you personally and plan your training in TrainingPeaks. I reply to messages within 3 hours.

pillars.title: Partners
pillars.text: I'm looking for companies to support me as a pro triathlete.

quote: We don't make progress in our comfort zone. Just like in other areas of life, in sport we go the extra mile together.
quoteAuthor: What I often tell my athletes
ctaText: Whether you're interested in coaching, want to support me or have a press enquiry: I read every message myself and will get back to you.
